content.title: Architectural Letterform Passage | Spatial Components and Plaza Lockup
content.summary: An adult gallery guide crosses an ivory sculpture campus whose beams assemble an original exhibition title. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One architectural site, one adult scale anchor and one movement axis establish the baseline. + Every typographic component is built from visible structures already registered in that site. + Successive openings preserve camera direction, floor geometry and pedestrian scale. + Letterforms may separate or enlarge but cannot replace the established architecture with an unrelated scene. + The terminal wide shot reunites complete site, subject and exact original title in one stable lockup.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish an original ivory sculpture campus with one adult gallery guide in a cobalt coat crossing a gridded plaza. Track the guide through the arch and beneath the beam while the same components separate into three readable spatial bays. Pull back to reunite the full campus, the guide and the rebuilt title "AXIS / ARRIVE" in one still architectural lockup.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先建立白色公共建筑和微小行人的稳定尺度，再让黑色字形构件与门洞、圆环和立柱共用空间骨架；镜头连续穿过可读孔洞，字形由标记升级为空间实体，终局回到完整广场。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One architectural site, one adult scale anchor and one movement axis establish the baseline.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One architectural site, one adult scale anchor and one movement axis establish the baseline."

invariants.rule: Every typographic component is built from visible structures already registered in that site.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every typographic component is built from visible structures already registered in that site."

invariants.rule: Successive openings preserve camera direction, floor geometry and pedestrian scale.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Successive openings preserve camera direction, floor geometry and pedestrian scale."

invariants.rule: Letterforms may separate or enlarge but cannot replace the established architecture with an unrelated scene.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Letterforms may separate or enlarge but cannot replace the established architecture with an unrelated scene."

invariants.rule: The terminal wide shot reunites complete site, subject and exact original title in one stable lockup.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal wide shot reunites complete site, subject and exact original title in one stable lockup."
